text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hmm… I just don't seem to have any get-up-and-go.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: But it's not like I'm sick or anything! I'm still brimming with youthful energy!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm not the kind of person who gets tired from this kind of thing! I just feel… a little off sometimes, you know?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'll be back on my game in no time, going full throttle and getting the whole stadium hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky insists she's fine, but maybe she needs some rest. It might be good to reassess her running schedule…
